# Choose an Agent

# Choose an Agent

An Agent is a configured way to work on a task. Agents can have different instructions, data access, skills, and tools. Choose one whose purpose and access match the work you are authorised to do.

## Choose from a new conversation

1. Open [Counso AI](https://app.counso.ai) and click **Create a new conversation**.
2. Open the selected-agent control and search for an Agent by name.
3. Choose an Agent from the search results, then write a small request that fits its stated purpose.

## Compare Agents before starting

The main new-conversation page also lists Agents with their descriptions. Use **All agents** or **Editable by me** there to browse the list before choosing. These list views are separate from the selected-agent search menu.

If the Agent list contains several similar options, prefer the one with the clearest description and the narrowest access needed for the task. Do not paste sensitive information into a conversation just to discover whether an Agent can use it.

## If an Agent is unavailable

An Agent may be hidden because of its publication state, access settings, or workspace configuration. Ask the workspace administrator to check your access and the Agent's intended audience. Available models and tools also depend on workspace configuration and permissions.

Selecting an Agent does not by itself confirm that a connected service will accept an action. Review the answer and verify consequential results in the destination system. To learn how to start the request after selecting an Agent, read [Start your first conversation](/en/getting-started/first-conversation/#start-your-first-conversation).
